assertions.name: every live defect names an observable
assertions.why: an entry that cannot say which number would move if it fired is a suspicion, not a defined problem

assertions.name: BOUND is claimed only where it can be true
assertions.why: outside the observation class, calling something a bound is an excuse for not fixing it, and it stops other people trying

assertions.name: the defect count does not shrink by deletion
assertions.why: entries are never deleted; a REFUTED entry is the record that stops an investigation being repeated
